IAEA chief says inspectors will visit Iran's nuclear sites under Iran-US interim deal
articles.desc: The head of the U.N.'s nuclear agency has signaled that Iranian nuclear enrichment sites would be visited by his inspectors, a day after U.S. and Iran offered contradictory remarks about the issue.

articles.title: U.S. lifts Iran oil sanctions. And, federal judge rules SAVE voter tool unlawful
articles.desc: The U.S. has temporarily lifted oil sanctions on Iran as peace talks continue. And, a federal judge ruled that the Trump administration's data system, known as SAVE, is unlawful.
